### 2026-10-18: After about 4 and a half hours of working on the track itself, and failing to do most of what I wanted to do with it, I finished my first entry, and moved on to a second entry. I did a timelapse for t

**0.75h**

After about 4 and a half hours of working on the track itself, and failing to do most of what I wanted to do with it, I finished my first entry, and moved on to a second entry. I did a timelapse for the first, but decided to try journaling for this one. I decided to try to add some pillars for the basic track, but failed to do so. I find it hard to work with Onshape's planes, which hurt my design now. I may spend another time figuring it out, but I'm on  a time limit here, so I couldn't take that time. Anyways, what I ACTUALLY got done is a funnel so I could learn how to use the tools associated with it. After the about 30 minutes struggling on pillars and a funnel in a different place, I decided to make it its own movable piece. Now, I can let it be an entrance or an exit based on whatever I feel like doing. It wasn't too hard to figure out, and was much more fun than trying to manipulate the planes on Onshape. After about 35 minutes of struggling (Which I forgot to screenshot), I was able to get that funnel done and finish the marble project.
Article that carried me through the project: https://github.com/karnxx/merbl/blob/main/guide.md
